About this Event

🔥 THE BOLLYWOOD THANKSGIVING TAKEOVER — FT. DJ DHARAK 🔥Thanksgiving dinner is just the warm-up. The real party starts at Madd Hatter, Hoboken! 🍾
Bollywood Bash Events brings you PRYM Events’ Bollywood Thanksgiving Takeover featuring DJ Dharak. Get your crew together for a night of Bollywood singalongs, Punjabi bangers, Hindi remixes, and club anthems that keep you on the dance floor.
📅 Thursday, November 26
⏰ Doors open at 9 PM | Party until 2 AM
📍 Madd Hatter — Hoboken, NJ
🔞 21+ only | Valid physical government-issued photo ID required

WHAT TO EXPECT🎧 DJ Dharak on the decks: High-energy sets packed with your favorite Desi hits and dance-floor anthems.🔥 Thanksgiving night out: Bring your friends, celebrate the holiday, and make a night of it.🍸 Drinks & cocktails: Available for purchase at the venue.🍾 VIP tables & bottle service: Give your crew a place to celebrate in style. For reservations, call or text 201-954-5839.Dress code: Dress to impress! Think stylish night-out looks and party-ready outfits.
🎟️ Lock in your tickets and send the plan to your group chat. This Thanksgiving, we’re taking over Madd Hatter!

TERMS & CONDITIONSAge & identification: This is a 21+ event. A valid, physical government-issued photo ID is required. Photos or digital copies of IDs will not be accepted.Tickets & entry: Each guest must have a valid ticket. Entry is subject to ID verification, venue capacity, and venue policies.Refund policy: All ticket sales are final. Tickets are non-refundable and non-exchangeable.Respectful conduct: Harassment, aggressive behavior, or inappropriate conduct toward guests, staff, or performers will not be tolerated and may result in removal without a refund.Photography & video: Photos and videos may be taken for promotional use.
